title: oedera montana
intro: Oedera montana, commonly known as Mountain Boneset, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Oedera montana include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in alleviating pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
